When all tabs are closed, Microsoft Edge will ask whether to continue using the browser after closing the last tab. This will keep the browser open when user closes their last tab, so they have an option to resume or start a new browsing task without launching the browser again. Users can manage the experience through the “Keep the Edge window open when closing the last tab” setting under edge://settings/appearance/browserBehavior or admins can control availability to this feature using the SpawnNtpOnLastTabCloseEnabled policy.

source_revision_excerpts.sr-37d331d3c3ebc91a4cd7ac43: Chrome status: Proposed. Today, the selectedcontent element works for single-selects but does nothing in a multi-select. This feature makes the selectedcontent element start working for multi-selects by cloning all options into the selectedcontent element and keeping their selectedness in sync in order to represent each selected option inside of the selectedcontent element. Authors can still style the cloned option and the original option independently, and the cloned but not selected options will be hidden by default in UA styles.
